description: Read the candidate's whole experience bank: every employment and the achievements attached to it, plus the ones attached to no place under `unplaced`. Each achievement carries a PROVENANCE — cv_import, stated_in_chat and manual mean the candidate asserted it and it may be cited on a CV; agent_inferred means a model read it into the record and it may NOT. Take evidence_id for cv_edit from here.
name: experience_list
